s1_cohesion_fee.title: Cohesion Fee
s1_cohesion_fee._comment: Society S1. Conds in sim/society/society_conds.gd; block verbs in quest_log.gd region W1. Debt change stays tiny (+1% on one inmate).

invoice.text: Block C has been unusually peaceful. A fee has been applied.

effects.title: Cohesion fee
effects.text: Your quiet inmates have been noted. Quiet is not an exemption.

ask.text: The block's elder asks you to cover the fee. Cohesion is a service. Services are billed.

pay.label: Pay the fee (15 refined)
pay.text: The fee is settled. The block remembers who paid.

refuse.label: Refuse
refuse.text: The ledger is patient. The block is not.
refuse.hint: Free. That block is upset. Petition fee +5% for 3 days.

redirect.label: Redirect it onto the Lifer
redirect.text: The Lifer volunteered. Nobody asked how.
redirect.hint: One Lifer's debt +1%. Other blocks uneasy.
